title: I Let My Blind Date Keep the Tipping Slider After They Halved Mine

parts.text: I met them at 7:12 p.m. and we agreed the app would split even. They slid my tip to 8 percent and theirs to 25 on the same check. I was thirty, holding a pasta I had not finished because they talked over every bite. "Service liked me," they said. I screenshotted the two sliders, paid my 8 as displayed, and left a note on the receipt: THEIR 25 IS THEIR 25. The server got my separate cash 20. My date asked why the app looked mean. I forwarded the screenshot. They keep the slider. I keep the pasta money. The next person can date a percentage.

social.video_title: They halved my tip on the shared slider — Part 1/1
social.description: Even split, 8 versus 25, a pasta interrupted. I paid the 8 and tipped cash. Would you have matched the 25?
